'''Nawara Blen''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] criminal who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Blen worked for a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation established by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] and at some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Blen was present in [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] [[Teeku]] and [[Koobis (Clone Wars)|Koobis]]. Using a modified [[transponder]], the trio summoned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' to [[Docking Bay 27 (Genarius)|Docking Bay 27]] in Tolea Biqua, and requested that [[Heroes of Cularin|the ship's crew]] transport a crate of illicit goods to Jan.<!--Jan who?-->
